items.title: Bracco, Avicenna.AI get FDA clearance for brain aneurysm AI software
items.excerpt: Bracco and Avicenna.AI received FDA 510(k) clearance for Uptunity Aneurysm, AI software that detects suspected saccular brain aneurysms larger than 3 mm on head CTA and tracks known aneurysms across exams. It is the first product in Bracco's Uptunity interpretive-AI portfolio.
items.rationale: Fresh FDA 510(k) clearance for a clinical CTA aneurysm detection/tracking tool, a concrete regulatory event that changes radiology workflow.

items.title: Challenges for human oversight in detecting system malfunctions in AI-assisted medical diagnostics
items.excerpt: In a randomized study of 48 physicians using an increasingly malfunctioning AI for cardiac auscultation, diagnostic performance fell alongside the AI's reliability, showing clinicians struggle to catch AI failures.
items.rationale: Randomized physician study showing 'human in the loop' fails to catch degrading AI; direct patient-safety implication for clinical AI oversight.

items.title: 삼성서울병원, 글로벌 의료 AI 기업 '하이디'와 협력
items.excerpt: 삼성서울병원이 하이디(Heidi)와 MOU를 맺고 자체 의료정보시스템 '다윈'에 진료 음성-텍스트 변환(앰비언트 AI 기록) 도입을 추진한다. 하이디의 첫 국내 진출로, 원격의료·예약용 AI 에이전트 협력도 포함된다.
items.rationale: Major Korean tertiary hospital bringing an ambient AI scribe into its own EMR — Heidi's first Korean deployment (assigned to medicine by cross-section rule).

items.title: 강원 공공병원에 '의료 AI 고속도로' 첫 개통
items.excerpt: 보건복지부가 강원대병원과 영월의료원을 실시간 연결하는 '공공의료 AI 고속도로'를 시범 개통했다. 전원부터 수술·퇴원·회송까지 AI로 잇고, 2029년까지 전국 72개 공공병원으로 확대한다.
items.rationale: Government-launched AI network linking public hospitals for transfer-to-discharge care, with a stated rollout to 72 public hospitals by 2029.

items.title: Dyania Health, Nvidia team up to bring clinical reasoning AI inside hospital networks
items.excerpt: Dyania Health will run its Synapsis clinical-reasoning AI on hospital-owned Nvidia systems so large-scale chart analysis (e.g., trial matching at Cleveland Clinic) happens without patient data leaving the hospital network.
items.rationale: On-premises deployment model for chart-reasoning AI (clinical-trial matching at Cleveland Clinic) that keeps patient data inside the hospital network.
